original_ai_output.title_zh: 逾1.5万名移民经莫桑比克从南非返回
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 国际移民组织记录到至少15394名移民因南非反移民示威相关暴力而经莫桑比克返回。据该组织移民流动监测调查，这些人于2026年4月至7月间从南非返回，其中多数为过境莫桑比克返国的马拉维公民。监测在莫桑比克与南非交界的Ressano Garcia口岸及与马拉维交界的Zóbuè口岸进行。

location.site: Ressano Garcia border post / Zóbuè border post
location.raw_text: Ressano Garcia border post, on the border between Mozambique and South Africa, and the Zóbuè border post, on the border with Malawi

key_facts.fact: 国际移民组织记录到至少15394名移民经莫桑比克从南非返回
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The International Organization for Migration (IOM) recorded at least 15,394 migrants returning from South Africa, passing through Mozambique

key_facts.fact: 返回原因与南非反移民示威相关暴力有关
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: due to violence related to anti-immigration demonstrations in that neighboring country

key_facts.fact: 这些移民于2026年4月至7月间从南非返回
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: these people returned from South Africa between April and July 2026

key_facts.fact: 返回者中多数为过境莫桑比克返国的马拉维公民，共11699人占76%
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: the majority of the migrants observed were citizens of Malawi transiting through Mozambique on their way back to their home country. These are 11,699 Malawians, corresponding to 76 percent

key_facts.fact: 监测在莫桑比克与南非及马拉维边境口岸进行
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Monitoring took place at the Ressano Garcia border post, on the border between Mozambique and South Africa, and at the Zóbuè border post, on the border with Malawi

uncertainties: 数据来自单一来源（国际移民组织调查经单一媒体报道），尚缺乏交叉验证
报道未说明南非反移民暴力事件的具体伤亡或规模
